The repo already exposes a bounded read-only notifier ABI shape in Zig and the survey should make that foothold explicit.
The existing list helper is the concrete live list-side foothold that this adjacent packet must keep reviewable.
The existing hlist helper is part of the same bounded list-surface packet and should be tracked alongside the list helper.
The exported C ABI currently covers list and hlist carriers only, which is an important part of the current interop boundary.
A focused replay is the smallest honest way to keep the binding-only notifier foothold and list-surface posture reviewable.
The docs tree needs an explicit note that matches the live binding-only notifier and list-helper state instead of implying extra missing packet members.
The next same-family product step belongs to `P13-L18`: a read-only notifier-chain helper rather than callback or registration behavior.
The paired exported-C follow-up also stays with `P13-L18`: the current exported C side still lacks a dedicated notifier header even though the Zig binding foothold exists.
